summary: Portable, high-impact foods useful in the first week.

items.description: A chunk of cooked meat.  It's filling and nutritious, but unseasoned and a bit bland.
Tasty meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.
uses: Smoked preservation extends shelf life to 24 days; great for base camps.

items.description: Low-sodium boiled and canned meat.  Contains most of the nutrition, but little of the savor of cooked meat.
uses: High protein ration that never spoils; heavy but shelf-stable.

items.description: Canned beans.  A staple among canned goods, these are reputedly good for one's coronary health.
uses: Crack open with can opener or knife; pairs with toast for morale.

items.description: Salty dried meat that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.
uses: Excellent travel snack: light weight, decent calories, long shelf life.

items.description: A concentrated mixture of fat and protein, first said to have been used as a nutritious high-energy food by the Querecho and Teya people of what is Texas today.  Composed of meat, tallow, and edible berries, it provides excellent nutrition in an easy to carry form.
uses: Stacks calories + fat for winter travel; tiny weight footprint.

items.description: Dried strips of sugary fruit paste.
uses: Sugar rush for quick morale; watch for thirst penalty.

items.description: An iconic and delicious fruit grown and enjoyed across the world, used for generations in folk medicine as doctor repellant.
A humble piece of bread, one of the single most important staple foods of human civilization since the dawn of agriculture.
uses: Combine with peanut butter for morale-positive sandwiches.

items.description: Dry and salty, these crackers will leave you quite thirsty.
Dry flakes of flattened grain.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, it also doubles as food for horses while dry.
uses: Cook with clean water to unlock morale bonus and warmth.

items.description: A filling and nutritious New England classic that has sustained pioneers and captains of industry alike.
uses: Warm breakfast: morale +5, good before long raids.

items.description: A brown goo that tastes very little like its namesake.  It's not bad, but it'll stick to the roof of your mouth.
uses: High calorie spread; combine with crackers or bread for portable meals.
